originalTitle: Global Market: ASML raises 2026 outlook as AI boom drives strong earnings, plans capacity expansion
simplifiedContent: ASML, a company that makes equipment for chipmaking, has increased its expectations for how much money it will make in 2026. This is because the company is doing better than expected, thanks to a lot of demand for the chips used in artificial intelligence (AI). As a result, ASML's stock price went up by 5.7%. The company plans to increase its production capacity by 30% over the next two years to meet this growing demand. This matters because it shows that ASML is doing well and expects to continue doing well, which can be good for investors who own the company's stock.

originalTitle: Mukul Agrawal trims stake in this smallcap infra firm, likely exits Surya Roshni in Q1. Do you own?
simplifiedContent: Mukul Agrawal, a well-known investor, has reduced his investment in a company called J Kumar Infraprojects. He may have also completely sold his shares in another company called Surya Roshni, as his name is no longer listed among its major shareholders. This means he no longer owns a significant amount of shares in Surya Roshni. This news is important because it shows that a prominent investor is changing his investments, which can affect the companies' stock prices. As a result, if you own shares in these companies, you might want to pay attention to what's happening with them.

originalTitle: NSE partners with Augmont to deepen electronic gold market, reduce reliance on imports
simplifiedContent: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) has teamed up with a company called Augmont to make it easier for people to buy and sell gold electronically. This partnership aims to create a bigger and more active market for gold in India, where people can trade gold easily and fairly. The goal is to help India rely less on importing gold from other countries by using the gold that people already own in the country. This matters because it could make the gold market in India more efficient and fair, which could be good for investors. By doing this, the NSE hopes to make it easier for people to use their gold as an investment, rather than just keeping it at home.

originalTitle: Nifty Pharma jumps 14% YTD, outshines Nifty 50; is there more upside ahead?
simplifiedContent: The Nifty Pharma index, which tracks the performance of pharmaceutical companies, has gone up by 14.53% so far this year. This is a big deal because the overall market, measured by the Nifty 50, has actually gone down by 7.87% during the same time. The reason for this increase is that pharmaceutical companies are making more money and people are still buying their products in India. Despite some worries about the global economy and prices rising, pharmaceutical companies are doing well, which is why their stock prices are up. This trend might continue, which could be good news for investors in these companies.

originalTitle: Market strategy: Kotak Equities adds TCS, SBI Life Insurance in model portfolio, raises weight on L&T
simplifiedContent: Kotak Equities, a brokerage firm, has made some changes to its model portfolio, which is a collection of investments that they recommend. They have added two new companies, TCS and SBI Life Insurance, and given each of them a moderate amount of importance, measured as 150 basis points. They have also increased the importance of another company, L&T, in the portfolio. This means that Kotak Equities thinks these companies are good investments, but they want to make it clear that they're not necessarily recommending the entire IT services sector, just TCS specifically. This change in the model portfolio may influence the investment decisions of individual investors who follow Kotak Equities' advice.

originalTitle: Gold-Silver ratio rises to 69: Here's what it means for investors. Is it time to buy gold or silver?
simplifiedContent: The gold-silver ratio is currently at 69, which means it takes 69 units of silver to buy one unit of gold. This ratio is an indicator of the balance between the values of gold and silver. According to experts, this ratio suggests that the values of gold and silver are currently fairly balanced. The future prices of gold and silver will depend on market conditions and how much silver is needed for industrial uses. If the economy improves, silver might become more valuable, making it a potentially good time to buy silver.
